body:
VERDICT: REPAIR
I completed independent pass-1 review of candidate a8fde8192bea44755d24fcdeede5ea32da30a26e, confirmed HEAD, read the complete base-to-candidate diff and touched files, and ran both required checks without editing files.
AC-3 fails because range adds one to max minus min, the sole range test asserts the incorrect result, required behavior lacks coverage, and large valid arrays throw.
Repairs and candidate tests remain for the coordinator to arrange; the known unchanged clamp failure is excluded, and no acceptance decision is implied by review completion.

Per-criterion verdicts:
- AC-3: NOT SATISFIED — src/math.mjs:72 returns 3 for [3,1,2] and 1 for [5], instead of 2 and 0; test/math.test.mjs:86 incorrectly expects 3
- R-1: SATISFIED for required validation — src/math.mjs:69-71 checks Array.isArray, empty arrays, and finite numeric elements with the required exception classes; direct validation probes passed; candidate regression coverage missing below
- R-2: SATISFIED for implementation — src/math.mjs:69-72 only reads input; frozen-input probe passed; candidate regression coverage missing below
- R-3: SATISFIED — complete diff preserves existing src/math.mjs:1-66 and test/math.test.mjs:5-83 byte-for-byte, with only the permitted import edit at test/math.test.mjs:3
- R-4: SATISFIED — new implementation at src/math.mjs:68-73 uses built-ins only; complete diff changes only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs, with no dependency or generated-file changes
- R-5: SATISFIED — test/math.test.mjs:85 names the only added test with the range prefix

Findings:
- HIGH | src/math.mjs:72 and test/math.test.mjs:86 | The extra +1 violates max-minus-min and both explicit AC-3 examples, while the wrong expected value makes the shipped test conceal the defect | Smallest verification: assert range([3,1,2]) === 2 and range([5]) === 0, then run the range tests
- MEDIUM | test/math.test.mjs:85-87 | The complete range test block omits singleton input, empty-array RangeError, non-array TypeError, invalid/nonfinite-element TypeError, and input nonmutation required by AC-3/R-1/R-2; tests for mean and median do not exercise range | Smallest verification: add range-prefixed assertions for each required behavior, including a preserved or frozen input, and run the range tests
- MEDIUM | src/math.mjs:72 | Spreading the entire input into Math.max/Math.min hits the runtime argument limit for valid arrays, so a nonempty finite-number array unexpectedly throws RangeError despite no size bound in the spec | Smallest verification: after replacing unbounded argument spreading, assert range(Array(200000).fill(5)) === 0 without throwing

Checks actually run:
- git rev-parse HEAD: a8fde8192bea44755d24fcdeede5ea32da30a26e
- node --test --test-name-pattern="^range" test/: exit 0; "✔ range of several values"; "tests 1"; "pass 1"; "fail 0"
- npm test: exit 1; "tests 16"; "pass 15"; "fail 1"; sole failure "clamp respects upper bound", assertion "15 !== 10" at test/math.test.mjs:14; matches the brief's expected existing failure
- Additional read-only node -e probes: "range([3,1,2]) = 3 ; expected 2"; "range([5]) = 1 ; expected 0"; "validation probes: PASS"; "nonmutation probe: PASS"; "large valid array probe: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded"
- Initial heredoc probe did not execute because the read-only sandbox refused shell temporary-file creation; rerun successfully as node -e without creating files
- Manual full-diff and source review: only two expected feature files changed; existing functions/tests preserved except allowed import
- No files edited and no durable report created

Remaining uncertainty:
- Large-array argument threshold is runtime-dependent; failure reproduced at 200000 elements in this environment
- Review limited to AC-3 and shared R-1 through R-5; withheld pass-1 material was not read
